# Roadmap

1. Publish the catalog/chain/interpolation/plural/negotiation kernel as
   0.1.0.
2. Add CLDR plural rules for languages adopting applications actually
   ship (one private function plus one dispatch branch each).
3. RFC 4647 Accept-Language q-value ranking, if header order ever proves
   insufficient in practice.
4. `{{`/`}}` template-side brace escaping, only when a real catalog needs
   a literal brace.
